condition: Casting a list/large_list/list_view array to fixed_size_list segfaults when a null slot has the wrong length and the child values array is empty with no data buffer (e.g. an all-null list read from IPC/Flight or the C Data Interface).
workaround: Before casting, check for chunks whose child values array is empty and build an all-null fixed_size_list array for them (e.g. pa.nulls(len(chunk), target_type)) instead of calling cast.
